Disposable AntennaTracker SITL in AUTO with a fake vehicle (system 2) position stream at five bearings, 300 to 1,000 m and 0 to 150 m up: NAV_CONTROLLER_OUTPUT target bearing matched the computed bearing in all five cases (90, 0, 180, 270, 45). The yaw servo output changed with bearing (1100 to 1900); in this first run the pitch servo output stayed at 1387 to 1392 and nav_pitch stayed 0. Cause found by rerun (sitl-evidence/tracker-alt-source/): with the default ALT_SOURCE=0 (baro) the tracker only updates the altitude difference from SCALED_PRESSURE, which the first test did not send. With SCALED_PRESSURE sent, nav_pitch was 11.15, 11.16, 3.52, 26.24 and 0.02 degrees for expected 11.31, 11.31, 3.58, 26.57 and 0; with ALT_SOURCE=1 or 2 it was within 0.04 degrees of expected (0.00 to 0.04 at 0 degrees) and the pitch servo output moved (1100 to 1900). The pitch servo values are single end-of-window samples, were not converted to angles and did not vary monotonically with elevation, so servo scaling is not verified. Only simulator outputs; no physical servos.
